verdict.rationale: Evidence shows API endpoint catalogs and docs pages (mercury-docs-12/13) plus an llms.txt index for agents (mercury-docs-14, mercury-probe-1), but there's no evidence of an interactive 'try it' console or runnable code examples embedded in the docs; a direct probe for OpenAPI spec files returned only 404s (mercury-probe-2), suggesting no public interactive spec/playground exists.
